This is a ''super-interesting'' question! I've asked this myself. We know they can't speak lies, but think them; can they print them? I have a vague memory of... Siuan, perhaps? saying that nope, they can't write lies either. 

However, I'm quite convinced the sisters spread the rumours they need by ''ordering'' their informants to lie, which technically is not a lie. We shall have to ask Sanderson! 

Good job raising the question.
